set.body: Found by S0.7b. Public ReportSources.study digests the whole study result as JSON and runs out of memory on the golden fixture even at 10 GB. Provide a streaming (or structural) result digest with the same identity guarantees, so the real backend (S3.7) can bind report sources publicly. Blocks S3.7.
set.title: ReportSources.study: streaming result digest (OOM on the golden fixture)
